title: Build on a numbered brief page builds exactly the brief on screen: a stale revisionId is refused with BRIEF_STALE before any action or charge, another place's revisionId is 404, a current one (shared or quality-written) is accepted on that revision
steps: With a throwaway TEST_DATABASE_URL, from apps/tracy-web run: node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern=#553 test/website-opportunities-doors.test.mjs
Read the TAP lines of the three #553 door tests.
expect: Test 'build from a brief page (#553): the shown brief is built while current…' reports ok: POST /api/website-opportunities/:id/demo/build with another opportunity's revisionId answers 404 with no wo_demo_action row and wo_demo_usage.used 0; with the current shared brief's revisionId it answers 202, actions[0].revisionId is that revision and the built wo_build.revision_id is that revision; after the brief rules move on the same revisionId answers 409 code BRIEF_STALE with body.revisionId, and the wo_demo_action count and wo_demo_usage.used stay as before the press; without revisionId the press is still 202 on another revision; a malformed revisionId is 400 INVALID_REVISION_ID.

Test 'build from a brief page (#553): a brief the quality workflow wrote…' reports ok: a revision written by revisionForAction with an editorial preparer (research_hash null) is GET /:id brief.current true and the brief page's press (workflow agent-demo/1, revisionId) answers 202 with actions[0].revisionId equal to it; once the opportunity's research changes the same press answers 409 BRIEF_STALE and brief.current is false.

Test 'build from a brief page in quality mode (#553)…' reports ok: with quality_mode apply the brief page's agent-demo/1 press with revisionId is 202, stored on that revision with protocol legacy; a quality-v1 press with revisionId answers 409 BRIEF_NOT_BINDABLE.

selectors.fence: the briefRevisionId check in acceptDemoActions, apps/tracy-web/src/opportunities-build/demo-actions.js; briefIsCurrent in revisions.js

evidence: Issue #553 (dev, develop 73b44d40d, action 11da348b): on the page of Brief 2 the Build form sent only the opportunity id and the server wrote and built a new Brief 3 from research that had completed after Brief 2.
fence: The real build door and acceptance transaction over a scratch Postgres with the real domain package; the quality brief is written by the real revision writer with an editorial double. Not exercised: the brief page in a browser, a real model, a running CMS.

tests: build from a brief page (#553): the shown brief is built while current
build from a brief page (#553): a brief the quality workflow wrote
build from a brief page in quality mode (#553)
